title: EchoFuzz: Empowering Smart Contract Fuzzing with Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.14475v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Smart contracts, serving as the cornerstone of decentralized applications, autonomously manage trillion-dollar digital assets, making them attractive targets for attacks. Fuzzing has emerged as a promising technique for detecting vulnerabilities in smart contracts, yet existing methods face two main challenges. (1) The logical gap in state transitions and combinatorial redundancy hinders effective tradeoffs between bug detection efficiency and state space exploration cost, leading to critical execution paths to be overlooked. translated_title: EchoFuzz：利用大语言模型赋能智能合约模糊测试
translated_abstract: 智能合约作为去中心化应用的基石，自主管理着数万亿美元的数字资产，使其成为攻击者眼中极具吸引力的目标。模糊测试已成为检测智能合约漏洞的一种有前景的技术，然而现有方法面临两个主要挑战：（1）状态转换中的逻辑差距和组合冗余阻碍了漏洞检测效率与状态空间探索成本之间的有效权衡，导致关键执行路径被忽视；（2）基于规则的序列变异策略存在路径冗余和缺乏合约逻辑引导的问题，造成性能瓶颈，阻碍了对深度漏洞导向路径的探索。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了EchoFuzz，一个由大语言模型引导的模糊测试框架，引入了易受攻击函数调用序列（VFCS）——即能够暴露漏洞的最小化、行为保持的执行路径。
tldr: EchoFuzz提出了一种由大语言模型引导的智能合约模糊测试框架，通过引入最小化且行为保持的易受攻击函数调用序列，解决了现有方法在状态转换逻辑差距、组合冗余以及基于规则变异策略性能瓶颈方面的两大挑战。
en_tdlr: EchoFuzz is an LLM-guided smart contract fuzzing framework that introduces minimal, behavior-preserving Vulnerable Function Call Sequences (VFCS) to overcome state transition logical gaps, combinatorial redundancy, and the performance bottlenecks of rule-based mutation strategies.
